subject: Request for quotation from Hofmann Textilwerk KG
body:
Hello,

please find our request for an air freight quotation attached, as a Word document (quotation-request.docx). It has all details of the shipment.

Please reply by mail with your all-in price in EUR.

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
